name: Assault Suit
blocked_sentences: Equipped creature gets +2/+2, has haste, can't attack you or planeswalkers you control, and can't be sacrificed.

needs.what: a static-ability form of the sacrifice prohibition -- a `cant_sacrifice` entry in `static_effects` taking an `affects` filter (here `{"attached": true}`) and lasting as long as the source is on the battlefield, so the permanents it names cannot be chosen to pay a sacrifice cost or be taken by the `sacrifice` op, with no duration word at all
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cant_sacrifice` exists only as a one-shot op: the loader requires both `objects` (resolved once, when the effect resolves) and a `duration`, and `this_turn` is the sole implemented duration, so it can express Call for Aid's "this turn" clause but not an Equipment's open-ended "equipped creature ... can't be sacrificed". Putting it in an ability's `effects` would also need something to make the ability fire, and there is no trigger for "becomes attached" in `trigger_events`; an Equipment's continuous grant is a static, and `static_effects` has no sacrifice prohibition of any kind. The near relatives all fail for the reasons the op's own docstring already records: `lock_abilities` stops only the permanent's own activated abilities and says nothing about an outlet elsewhere or about the `sacrifice` op, `replace_deaths` redirects the card after the sacrifice has already been paid for, and `grant_keyword` indestructible is explicitly not a sacrifice prohibition (701.17a).
